messages:
Sam: Heads-up — hit an ambiguous route match during a tenant test. Gateway matched /v1/tenants/42 by path, but the edge proxy sent an X-Model-Force header that applied a different model variant. Which wins today? @Anya :eyes:
Anya: IIRC header overrides currently take precedence in the old matcher logic. That was intentional for some legacy clients, but its confusing for tenant fallbacks. We should clarify the rules in config and console UX.
Kevin: That behavior is causing tenant-specific fallback configs to be bypassed. Example: tenant-A has fallback -> "llama-7b-quantized", but header X-Model-Force: "small" forces a CPU path instead and we avoid the GPU fallback. Breaks SLA.
Maria: FYI ops-bot shows a CB spike around the time which made things worse — gateway retried then we saw 429s -> 503s. We need clear precedence + SLO-aware fallback so retries don't amplify failures.
Li: Proposal: add an explicit `match_precedence` field to route config (enum or ordered list) and a `fallback_order` array. That makes intent explicit and avoids hidden behavior. Console can present a compact visual for precedence.
Sam: Also add telemetry for when an override is applied: `routing.override_applied` with tags {route_id, override_type, source, applied_by_header}. We need an alert if overrides spike for a tenant.
Anya: Example config snippet (proto-ish):
```
route {
  id: "tenant-A"
  match_precedence: "header,path,query"
  fallback_order: "same-variant,quantized,smaller-model,cpu-offload"
}
```
Kevin: For circuit-breaker behavior: emit `cb_open` events that include lane, tenant, and reason (queue-depth/cpu/gpu-util). Console should surface per-route `cb_open_rate` and correlate with `fallback_used`.
Maria: UX ask: when users create rollouts, let them pin different fallback profiles per stage. Canary -> quantized fallback, Prod -> smaller-model fallback. Right now fallback is global per-route which makes rollouts risky.
Li: I'll draft a small DB migration to add `match_precedence` and `fallback_order` columns and wire them into the route editor. Backend PR incoming, I can own it.
ops-bot: alert: 1718502502 circuit-breaker open tenant=tenant-A lane=gpu-1 threshold=0.85
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/route-match-precedence -> staging
Sam: Can we standardize a default safe ordering: header_override -> explicit_route_match -> path_regex -> catchall? At least make it explicit rather than hidden.
Anya: +1 to defaults. But keep backward compatibility: default to current implicit rules unless a route explicitly sets precedence. Rollout should let us flip per-tenant.
Kevin: Tests: add e2e that simulates header override + path match and asserts the chosen fallback used and that telemetry `override_applied` is emitted. Also assert retries don't cause double-fallback.
Maria: I'll add dashboard cards: `override_applied` count (by tenant), `cb_open_rate`, `fallback_used` breakdown (same-variant / quantized / smaller-model / cpu-offload).
Li: Timeline: backend PR by EOD tomorrow, console mock by Thu, canary next week.
Sam: Cool — moving the RFC into the doc: https://internal.redwood/drafts/route-precedence (placeholder). Thanks all.
